message:
## Start here
The config loads options, keymaps, autocommands, and LSP setup before plugins.

## Plugins
Neovim's built-in package manager installs and loads the plugins listed here. Navi is one of them.

## AI in the editor
99 uses an AI CLI for codebase search and visual selection replacement. Press Space 9 s to try its search.

## Agent review
CodeDiff shows file changes while an agent works. Press Space d d to open the review view.
